resources.string: Sakshi keeps evidence that you choose to import. It stores that evidence on this device, encrypted. This version of the app has no permission to use the network.
It cannot read chats in other apps. It cannot recover deleted messages or view-once messages. It cannot confirm who sent a message.
A stored fingerprint (hash) of a file shows that the file has not changed since it was saved. It does not show that the file is genuine.
If you uninstall Sakshi, or the device key is lost, the stored data cannot be recovered.
Anyone who can unlock this phone can open Sakshi.
Files you export are no longer under Sakshi\'s control.
Use your fingerprint, face or screen lock to open it.
Unlock was not completed. You can try again when you are ready.

Sakshi needs a PIN, pattern or password set on this phone before it can store anything. Set one in the phone settings, then return here.

The key that opens Sakshi\'s data on this device was invalidated. This usually happens after the screen lock or the saved fingerprints or faces changed. The stored data can no longer be opened by this app.
